def get_func_fqname(func: Callable[..., Any]) ->str:
    module = getattr(func, '__module__', None)
    qualname = getattr(func, '__qualname__', None)
    if module is None or qualname is None:
        raise NameLookupError(f"Cannot determine fully qualified name for {func}")
    return f"{module}.{qualname}"


def get_func_in_module(module: str, qualname: str) ->Callable[..., Any]:
    mod = importlib.import_module(module)
    obj = get_name_in_module(module, qualname)
    if not callable(obj):
        raise InvalidTypeError(f"{module}.{qualname} is not callable")
    return obj


def get_name_in_module(module: str, qualname: str, attr_getter: Optional[
    Callable[[Any, str], Any]]=None) ->Any:
    mod = importlib.import_module(module)
    if attr_getter is None:
        attr_getter = getattr
    parts = qualname.split(".")
    obj = mod
    for part in parts:
        obj = attr_getter(obj, part)
    return obj
